<!-- pr-reviewer: 86b3393a2cd5e9a9a8a83c9b77ff16d82c3b22d9 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Default search limit is now `default_overtravel(tolerance) = max(2 x tol, 1 mm)` (`crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs:961`, `probe_op.rs`), so a new op searches 1 mm. Existing documents keep their stored `overtravel`: the seed is the only place that changed, no migration is needed and no project-format change.
- `Warning::ProbeSearch` is non-blocking (`crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs`, `blocks_post`), so old 5 mm documents still post. It is wired into every exhaustive match: MCP `job.rs`, `warned_moves.rs`, and the UI fold in `ui/src/operations.rs`.
- Prime Directive on the path (`crates/motion/src/probing.rs:254-262`): the cycle opens with a zero-length rapid at the safe plane over the first start, then FEEDS to the approach plane. Every later travel rapid goes to `home(start)`, which is the safe plane, and every descent from it is a feed. I found no probe rapid below the safe plane in any mode. `probe_cycle` still refuses a safe plane at or under the approach plane by name. No unwrap/expect/panic in non-test code, no new casts or indexing.
- Protected descent is posted as a protected move: Fanuc `G31` plus the `#5063` check with `#3000=3`, Tormach `G38.3` plus the `#5070 EQ 1` check with `M2`. The only probe-capable posts are fanuc.cps and tormach.cps (the other dialects have no probe handling), and both are covered.
- Golden diffs are exactly as stated. Fanuc: the old `G00 X Y Z25` becomes `G00 X Y Z50`, then `G31 ... Z25 F300`, then the alarm line. The four files change only in those lines, and nothing else moves. Tormach `probe_guard_moves.nc`: one extra guarded descent, and the `o5001..o5005` numbering shifts as a consequence. The tests rewrote no golden on my run (clean tree afterwards).
- Existing-document output changes only by that opening protected feed. `probe_op`/`fanuc_post` fixtures keep 5 mm, so the later seek targets are unchanged.
- Process: `Fixes #570`, `Changelog:` line, decision file under `docs/decisions/`, no CHANGELOG.md edit, no `build.rs`/`.github`/scripts/dependency changes, no assets.

**Local results (PR head, which already contains current upstream/main - the trial merge was "Already up to date")**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | ok |
| app: probe_search 3, probe_guard 5, probe_op 11, probe_reach 5, probe_pick 9, fanuc_post 11, posting 17, conformance 6 | all pass |
| `camcraft-motion` and `camcraft-sim`, whole crates | all pass |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 376 pass, 1 fail (environmental, below) |
| `cargo clippy -p motion -p sim -p app -p ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

```
egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds --- FAILED
egui headless run failed: No suitable graphics adapter found; ...
```
That is the headless-GPU limit of this host, not a defect of the PR.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- `ui/src/operations.rs`: the fold key `214` for `ProbeSearch` follows `212 + part` for `HolderHit`. That is fine while a lathe has at most 2 parts; if a third ever exists it would collide. A named constant range would make it explicit.
- Changing the tolerance on an existing op does not re-derive its `overtravel` (by design, "existing documents keep their stated value"); the new hint text plus the 2 mm advisory cover it.
- The real-machine run of this post on the 770MX is still unexercised (as the PR says); the Fanuc/Tormach goldens and the tests pin the output.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
